entry.title: Add tests for EPUB import and learning functionality
entry.content:
Add tests for EPUB import and learning functionality

- Implement tests for the `saveEpubWithChapters` function to ensure successful chapter identification and error handling during EPUB import.
- Create tests for various learning policies, including interleaving old weak words, managing daily new quotas, and sibling card burying logic.
- Introduce new IPC interfaces for learning operations, including session management and card handling.
- Develop the learning module with policies for managing learning sessions, candidate cards, and review operations.
- Add recovery storage functionality to manage draft states in the learning database.
- Implement tests for the word store to validate reader state classification and rollback behavior on IPC failures.

feat(learning): whole-loop hub, word-profile recall, review memory anchors

  SRS load, local-timezone review-activity strip, material totals.

  due/learning/new-this-week/reviews-today cards, funnel bar, i+1
  next-read recommendations, practice pool with level chips.
- WordProfileDrawer replaces MaterialsForWordDrawer everywhere; clicks
  route by source kind (stories deep-link into StoryView via the new
  openStoryId prop; documents load fully into the Reader — fixes stale
  reader text when opening from the drawer).
- ReviewSession shows "where you met it" sentences after reveal and
  recaps Again/Hard words as drill chips on the done screen.

entry.title: feat(dictionary): auto-search lookup a beat after typing stops
entry.content:
feat(dictionary): auto-search lookup a beat after typing stops

Fire the dictionary lookup automatically 450ms after the last keystroke, so looking up a word no longer needs an Enter press or Search click. A lastLookupRef guards the debounce against the on-mount autoSearch path, trailing-whitespace re-normalization, linked-entry navigation, and the Back button, so only fresh typing re-fires the request.

Covered by two new WordLookupModal tests: fires after typing, and does not auto-fire the initial query when autoSearch is off.

a new `buildDictionaryFrameSrcDoc` vitest covering doctype/head/fragment paths.

entry.title: docs(skill): document traps #13-15 from v0.2.0 (cask license, updater…
entry.content:
docs(skill): document traps #13-15 from v0.2.0 (cask license, updater darwin keys, Gatekeeper)

Three traps surfaced post-tag for v0.2.0:

  #13 — homebrew cask used `license "MIT"`, which is formula-only DSL;
        every release v0.1.7 → v0.2.0 shipped a syntactically broken
        cask. CI didn't catch it because gh api PUT doesn't parse Ruby.
  #14 — release.yml emitted only `darwin-universal` in latest.json,
        but Tauri's updater queries `darwin-aarch64` / `darwin-x86_64`.
        Apple Silicon installs hit "None of the fallback platforms […]
        were found".
  #15 — un-notarized brew installs are quarantined; users see "WordBrain
        is damaged". Documented xattr workaround until APPLE_*
        notarization secrets are wired.

Also extends the skill's frontmatter description so future invocations
match on these post-release symptoms (brew install failure, fallback-
platforms updater error, Gatekeeper damaged-app prompt).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
